cohort: 58 pregnant women diagnosed with COVID-19 infection and anemia at a tertiary care center between April 1, 2020, and June 30, 2021.
finding: Anemia in COVID-19-positive pregnant women did not appear to negatively affect maternal or neonatal outcomes.
gest_age: 77% of the women reached full-term pregnancy
birth_weight: 38.8% of neonates had a birth weight <2.5 kg
